# `pos ticket` commands

## `pos ticket discard`

Discard a held or resumed ticket at expected_version, keeping its audit history. Posts nothing. Needs pos.sell; off unless pos_enabled is on.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | member |
| Capability | pos.sell |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/pos.ticket.discard` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow pos ticket discard counter-cart-1 --expected-version 2 --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "pos ticket discard", "input": {"ticket": "counter-cart-1", "expected_version": 2}, "company": "Company ID or name", "dry_run": true, "reason": "Preview the requested change"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ticket` | `TICKET` | string | yes | no | — | The ticket's key, chosen by the device when the sale starts (a ULID or any 1-64 letters, digits, '.', '_', ':' or '-'). It is the sale's operation key: completing again with the same key returns the sale already posted and never posts a second.; pattern "^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,63}$" |
| `device` | `--device` | string | no | no | "unknown" | Device identity for ticket hand-off audit.; minimum length 1; maximum length 128 |
| `expected_version` | `--expected-version` | integer | yes | no | — | Ticket version returned by hold, list or resume.; minimum 1 |

### Command and context options

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Print one JSON object. |
| `--data-root TEXT` | Data root; otherwise `BOOKFLOW_DATA_ROOT`, then `~/.bookflow`. |
| `--dry-run` | Validate and preview without writing. |
| `--reason TEXT` | Short reason for the write. |
| `--source-ref TEXT` | Identifier of the source that triggered the write. |
| `--interactive` | Prompt for input fields not supplied as arguments or options. |
| `--directive TEXT` | Standing-instruction code or id cited by the write. |
| `--idempotency-key TEXT` | Retry-safe key for this create command. |
| `--company TEXT` | Company id, `Organization/Company`, or display name. |

### HTTP

Route: `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/pos.ticket.discard`

Send the input object as JSON. Authentication may instead come from a browser session cookie.

| Header | Requirement | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | required for bearer clients | `Bearer <secret>` |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Name` | optional | Stable caller name recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Version` | optional | Caller version recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Context-Encoding` | optional | percent-utf8: encode all reason, source-ref, directive, idempotency-key, client-name and client-version header values as UTF-8 percent encoding |
| `X-Bookflow-Company` | optional | If sent, must equal the company ULID in the route |
| `X-Bookflow-Reason` | conditional | Short reason; an agent or system write needs this or an active directive |
| `X-Bookflow-Source-Ref` | optional | Identifier of the source that triggered the write |
| `X-Bookflow-Directive` | conditional | Active directive code or id; alternative to reason for an agent or system write |
| `Idempotency-Key` | optional | Retry-safe key for this create command |

### Output

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `version` | integer | yes | no | — | — |

## `pos ticket hold`

Hold a cart on the host, shared across devices. Posts nothing and reserves no stock. Optional label defaults to time and first item. A previously resumed ticket requires its expected_version. Needs pos.sell; explicit prices follow pos.price-override. Off unless pos_enabled is on.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | member pos.sell; pos.price-override when a line has unit_price |
| Capability | pos.sell |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/pos.ticket.hold` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow pos ticket hold --ticket counter-cart-1 --label "Casey collecting" --lines '[{"item":"Pipe Sealant","quantity":"2"}]' --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "pos ticket hold", "input": {"ticket": "counter-cart-1", "label": "Casey collecting", "lines": [{"item": "Pipe Sealant", "quantity": "2"}]}, "company": "Company ID or name", "dry_run": true, "reason": "Preview the requested change"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `pos_register` | `--pos-register` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Register ID or name; omitted when the company has one. |
| `customer` | `--customer` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Customer ID or name, from `pos customer search` or `add`. Omitted, the sale is the register's walk-in customer's, which the POS screen and the receipt never show. |
| `lines[].item` | inside `--lines` JSON array | string | yes | no | — | Item ID or name.; minimum length 1; maximum length 1004 |
| `lines[].quantity` | inside `--lines` JSON array | string | no | no | "1" | Quantity, in the item base unit; default 1. |
| `lines[].unit_price` | inside `--lines` JSON array | string \| null | no | yes | null | A typed unit price, overriding the register's price (needs pos.price-override). Omitted, the price is the sales receipt's own: the item price, the customer's price level and the price rules. |
| `lines[].serial_numbers` | inside `--lines` JSON array | array[string] \| null | no | yes | null | Serial numbers of the units sold, for a serial-tracked item; omitted, the units stay unassigned, as the sales receipt allows. |
| `ticket` | `--ticket` | string | yes | no | — | The ticket's key, chosen by the device when the sale starts (a ULID or any 1-64 letters, digits, '.', '_', ':' or '-'). It is the sale's operation key: completing again with the same key returns the sale already posted and never posts a second.; pattern "^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,63}$" |
| `device` | `--device` | string | no | no | "unknown" | Device identity for ticket hand-off audit.; minimum length 1; maximum length 128 |
| `label` | `--label` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Optional label; default hold time and first item. |
| `expected_version` | `--expected-version` | integer \| null | no | yes | null | Required when holding a previously resumed ticket. |

## `pos ticket resume`

Claim a held ticket at expected_version; returns its cart, preserving explicit prices. Preview the returned cart for today’s prices before charging. The new version is required for completion or another hold. Posts nothing. Needs pos.sell; off unless pos_enabled is on.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | member |
| Capability | pos.sell |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/pos.ticket.resume` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow pos ticket resume counter-cart-1 --expected-version 1 --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "pos ticket resume", "input": {"ticket": "counter-cart-1", "expected_version": 1}, "company": "Company ID or name", "dry_run": true, "reason": "Preview the requested change"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ticket` | `TICKET` | string | yes | no | — | The ticket's key, chosen by the device when the sale starts (a ULID or any 1-64 letters, digits, '.', '_', ':' or '-'). It is the sale's operation key: completing again with the same key returns the sale already posted and never posts a second.; pattern "^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,63}$" |
| `device` | `--device` | string | no | no | "unknown" | Device identity for ticket hand-off audit.; minimum length 1; maximum length 128 |
| `expected_version` | `--expected-version` | integer | yes | no | — | Ticket version returned by hold, list or resume.; minimum 1 |

| `--company TEXT` | Company id, `Organization/Company`, or display name. |

Route: `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/pos.ticket.resume`

Send the input object as JSON. Authentication may instead come from a browser session cookie.
